faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Standard builds typically ship in 4–8 weeks after deposit and drawing sign-off. In-stock units can leave sooner.
faq.q2: Is there a minimum order quantity?
faq.a2: No MOQ. One trailer is fine — factory-direct, including custom layouts.
faq.a3: Usually a deposit to start production, balance before shipment. We confirm terms on the quote.
faq.a4: Export crate packing is included. We arrange sea freight or load at the port you specify.
faq.a5: One-year factory warranty on structure and workmanship. We support with photos, parts, and remote guidance.
faq.a6: Yes. Book a visit to Jiangsu — we walk the line from welding to packing.
